The extension is fully scaffolded and compiles cleanly. Here's a summary of what was created under [`extensions/origit-vscode/`](extensions/origit-vscode/):

---

### Files created

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`package.json`](extensions/origit-vscode/package.json) | Manifest — publisher `origit`, `^1.90.0` engine, SCM view, commands, menus, status-bar configuration |
| [`tsconfig.json`](extensions/origit-vscode/tsconfig.json) | strict, ES2022, commonjs, `outDir out`, `rootDir src` |
| [`src/origit.ts`](extensions/origit-vscode/src/origit.ts) | All CLI calls — `fetchLog`, `fetchSessionStatus`, `fetchTaint`, `fetchRecord`; CLI resolution via setting → git config → PATH |
| [`src/tree.ts`](extensions/origit-vscode/src/tree.ts) | `OrigitTreeProvider` + node types `SessionNode`, `CommitNode`, `GroupNode`, `LeafNode`, `ErrorNode` |
| [`src/extension.ts`](extensions/origit-vscode/src/extension.ts) | Activation, commands, status bar, FileSystemWatcher, 15-second timer |
| [`README.md`](extensions/origit-vscode/README.md) | View description, install instructions, config reference, "no own logic" statement |
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](extensions/origit-vscode/CHANGELOG.md) | 0.1.0 entry |
| [`.vscodeignore`](extensions/origit-vscode/.vscodeignore) | Excludes `src/`, `out/`, `node_modules/` from VSIX |

---

### Design notes

- **No bundler** — plain `tsc`, `main` points to `out/extension.js`.
- **Tree depth**: Session → Commit (with severity circle / taint error icon) → [Approver leaf, Tests leaf, Record sha256 leaf, Read group, Wrote group, Dependencies group].
- **Taint**: kept in memory in `currentTaintShas: Set<string>`; `provider.setTaint()` re-renders only commit nodes, `origit.clearTaint` resets. The info banner follows the spec: `"<n> commits affected · sessions <labels> · roll back to <short sha>"`.
- **Status bar** (`$(record)` / `$(circle-outline)`) falls back to reading `.origit/session.json` when the CLI command fails.
- **Error handling**: any failure in `fetchLog` shows a single `ErrorNode("Origit CLI not found: …")` instead of throwing, so the view never crashes.
